Cabin Safety

Automated external defibrillator

A portable device that analyzes cardiac rhythm and delivers electrical shocks to restore normal heart rhythm during cardiac arrest.

Quick answer: A portable device that analyzes cardiac rhythm and delivers electrical shocks to restore normal heart rhythm during cardiac arrest.

Why it matters

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Automated external defibrillator?

In this glossary, Automated external defibrillator refers to: A portable device that analyzes cardiac rhythm and delivers electrical shocks to restore normal heart rhythm during cardiac arrest.

How is Automated external defibrillator used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Cabin crew retrieved automated external defibrillator after passenger collapse; device applied and medical assistance coordinated on ground."

Why does Automated external defibrillator matter in aviation?

Automated external defibrillator matters because it supports clear communication in Cabin Safety contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Automated external defibrillator is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.
